implementations.operational_change: After section one, stop assessment work, provide a supervised 10-minute break, then resume with section two; retain 36 minutes of assessment working time. Required session: 14:00–14:46.

calculated_timing.calculation: 36 minutes working time + 10-minute break = 46 elapsed minutes; 14:00 + 46 minutes = 14:46. Available session ends at 14:42, leaving a 4-minute shortfall.
